name: turnip mashed potatoes
instructions:
Generalized turnip/potato mash (renamed from 'mashed potatoes' 2026-11-16).

1. BOIL turnips and/or potatoes.
2. MASH and mix with HEAVY CREAM, SALT, and BUTTER.
3. GRATIN with CHEDDAR CHEESE or GRAVY ([[chicken-veloute]]).
notes:
=== GENERALIZED — TURNIPS AND/OR POTATOES ===

Any ratio of turnips and potatoes works (same and/or logic as [[dauphinois]]).

=== THE GRATIN FINISH — CHEDDAR OR GRAVY ===

Gratin with cheddar cheese or gravy. The gravy is [[chicken-veloute]] — these chicken gravies taste best with this mash and poached chicken breast.
